title: Alcoholic Drinks - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue, at home (e.g., revenue generated in supermarkets and convenience stores) in the Alcoholic Drinks market amounts to US$1.08tn in 2026.
Revenue, out-of-home (e.g., revenue generated in restaurants and bars) amounts to US$622.77bn in 2026.
Revenue, combined amounts to US$1.70tn in 2026.
The revenue, at home is expected to grow annually by 2.96% (CAGR 2026-2030).
In global comparison, most revenue, at home is generated China (US$207bn in 2026).
In relation to total population figures, the average revenue per capita, at home of US$136.25 are generated in 2026.
In the Alcoholic Drinks market, volume, at home is expected to amount to 219.68bn L by 2026.
Volume, out-of-home is expected to amount to 62.10bn L in 2026.
Volume, combined is expected to amount to 281.79bn L in 2026.
The Alcoholic Drinks market is expected to show a volume growth, at home of 0.1% in 2027.
The average volume per person, at home in the Alcoholic Drinks market is expected to amount to 27.79L in 2026.
